errors.text_span: Най-високата подкрепа има мярката „Да се намали корупцията“ с 13%
errors.evidence: The figure shows that „Да се повиши ефективността на съдебната система“ has the highest value, not „Да се намали корупцията“ (which is also 13% but not the highest). The description incorrectly assigns the highest value to the wrong category.
The description incorrectly refers to the color for higher percentages as 'розови' (pink), but the figure uses red ('червен').
The description incorrectly limits blue bars to 2%–5%, but the figure shows blue bars for values up to 9% (e.g., „Да се засили данъчния контрол“ is 9% and blue).
The description incorrectly states that pink (red) bars represent 9%–13%, but the figure shows red bars only for values above 10% (e.g., 13%). The 9% bar is blue.
The description does not explicitly state that the chart shows the *five most significant* measures, as indicated in the atom checklist (chart_type).
The description omits the exact percentage for „Да се повиши ефективността на съдебната система“, which is the highest value in the figure.
The description does not mention that the vertical axis (percentage scale) is not clearly labeled in the figure.
The description omits the category „Да се приемат по-строги закони“ (5%) entirely.
The description claims the horizontal axis ranges from 0% to 15%, but the figure does not explicitly show this range. The highest value is 13%, and no axis ticks are visible.

errors.text_span: Останалите мерки имат стойности между 3% и 10%
errors.evidence: The description oversimplifies the values by grouping them into a broad range, whereas the figure shows specific values for each category (e.g., 3%, 5%, 9%, 10%).

errors.text_span: Най-високата подкрепа има мярката „Да се намали корупцията“ с 13%, следвани от „Да се въведат по-ефективни стимули за бизнеса“ и „Да се подобри качеството на административните услуги“ — и двете с 13%
errors.evidence: The description is ambiguous about which measure has the highest value, as it incorrectly states „Да се намали корупцията“ as the highest, while also listing two other measures with the same value (13%). The figure shows „Да се повиши ефективността на съдебната система“ as the longest bar.
